title: Bun SQLite migration runner
context: Applies SQL migration files named <version>_<name>.sql (versions are unpadded integers: 1, 2, ... 10, 11) in ascending numeric version order. Each migration and its schema_migrations record must be applied atomically. If a migration fails, migrate must stop and throw so nothing later runs.
code: export async function migrate(dbPath: string, dir: string) {
db.run("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL)");
(db.query("SELECT version FROM schema_migrations").all() as { version: number }[]).map((r) => r.version),
for await (const f of new Glob("*.sql").scan(dir)) files.push(f);
const record = db.query("INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version, name, applied_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");

expected.why: lexicographic sort runs 10_x before 2_y; unpadded versions must be sorted numerically
the migration and its record are not wrapped in one transaction, so a failure partway leaves a half-applied, unrecorded migration
a failed migration is logged and skipped, so later migrations run against a broken schema; it must stop and rethrow
